long: Diablo II is an isometric action RPG and hack-and-slash dungeon crawler in which players battle through randomized levels, collecting loot and developing a character across skill trees. The Lord of Destruction expansion adds two new character classes, a fifth act, and expanded itemization. This build supports local and LAN multiplayer for cooperative play and player-versus-player duels.
name: Diablo II + Lord of Destruction
short: Diablo II + Lord of Destruction (CJ_Strife portable, via Proton and gamescope)
